name: ainet_free
description: AINet::Free walks and frees each owned AINetNode, then frees the AINet object itself; null this-pointers are ignored.
known_limits: VC5SP3 byte verification passes under the /MD CRT import-call AINet source target. Source keeps separate current-node and traversal-cursor locals so VC5 saves esi immediately and loads next before freeing the current node, matching retail.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x403800 returns immediately for a null this-pointer, loads nodeListHead from offset 80, walks each node through the next pointer at offset 44, calls AINetNode::Free for every node, then calls the CRT free provider on the AINet object.
Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x403800 has no warnings or tags and shows the same null guard, node-list loop, AINetNode::Free call, and final free(aiNet).
The dependency frontier for 0x403800 has no visible source blockers after accepting AINetNode::Free; the remaining free call is a CRT provider.
The native ainet_free_all_smoke constructs an AINet with an owned node chain and verifies the global free-all path clears the list while exercising AINet::Free.
tier_s_evidence: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x403800 --build-root build\vc5-verify-403800-current-split passed with zero unmasked byte mismatches after 8 relocation-masked bytes under vc5_o2_ob0_md_facs; BN size 42, VC object symbol size 48, 6 trailing VC NOP bytes trimmed.
